Class SpatialHeatmapCanvasRenderer

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.ui.heatmap.SpatialHeatmapCanvasRenderer
public final class SpatialHeatmapCanvasRenderer extends Object
Handles multi-layer 2D cartographic canvas rendering, categorized layer menu construction, active layer chip pills, and hover magnifier popup behavior for SpatialHeatmapPanel.
Version:
2.0.0
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot

  • Method Details

    • renderMapOnCanvas

      public static void renderMapOnCanvas(javafx.scene.canvas.Canvas canvas, List<H3Cell> currentCells, Set<DisplayMode> activeLayers, javafx.scene.control.Label lblMoranI, boolean computeMoran)
      Renders the composite multi-layer heatmap and optional Moran's \(I\) spatial autocorrelation label.
      Parameters:
      canvas - target JavaFX canvas
      currentCells - active H3 spatial cells
      activeLayers - ordered set of active thematic display modes
      lblMoranI - label displaying Moran's \(I\) index (updated when computeMoran is true)
      computeMoran - whether to evaluate and display Moran's \(I\) on the primary scalar layer

    • buildLayerMenu

      public static void buildLayerMenu(javafx.scene.control.MenuButton activeLayersMenuBtn, Map<DisplayMode, javafx.scene.control.CheckBox> layerCheckBoxMap, Set<DisplayMode> activeLayers, BiConsumer<DisplayMode, Boolean> onLayerToggled)
      Populates the categorized MenuButton with checkboxes for every DisplayMode.
      Parameters:
      activeLayersMenuBtn - target menu button
      layerCheckBoxMap - registry mapping display modes to their menu checkboxes
      activeLayers - currently enabled layers
      onLayerToggled - callback invoked when a layer checkbox changes state

    • updateActiveLayerChips

      public static void updateActiveLayerChips(javafx.scene.layout.FlowPane activeLayersChipsBox, javafx.scene.control.MenuButton activeLayersMenuBtn, Set<DisplayMode> activeLayers, Map<DisplayMode, javafx.scene.control.CheckBox> layerCheckBoxMap, Runnable onChipsUpdated)
      Synchronizes removable active-layer chip pills with the current activeLayers set.
      Parameters:
      activeLayersChipsBox - target FlowPane container for layer chips
      activeLayersMenuBtn - menu button whose title displays active layer count
      activeLayers - active display modes
      layerCheckBoxMap - checkbox map updated when a chip is dismissed
      onChipsUpdated - callback triggered after removing a layer chip

    • setupHoverPopup

      public static void setupHoverPopup(javafx.scene.canvas.Canvas mapCanvas, javafx.stage.Popup hoverPopup, javafx.scene.canvas.Canvas popupCanvas, Runnable onRenderPopup)
      Configures the enlarged 560x280 hover magnifier popup over the compact heatmap canvas.
      Parameters:
      mapCanvas - primary compact canvas
      hoverPopup - popup window instance
      popupCanvas - enlarged canvas rendered inside popup
      onRenderPopup - callback rendering the current map onto popupCanvas
